g.text: $ cat ~/story.md

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: who

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: I am Vigneshwar. I build backend and systems software, and I help train

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: the models that are starting to write it too.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: Most of my work has been for other people's companies at the point where

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: nothing exists yet: clients, early-stage startups, founders and

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: co-founders who need the first version to actually work.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: what I build

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: Models, reinforcement-learning environments, agents and RAG systems on

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: one side. Storage engines, distributed systems and backend services on

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: the other.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: The two halves inform each other more than people expect. Knowing where

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: latency really comes from makes you a better engineer of AI systems, not

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: just a better backend developer.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: 2023 — starting

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: I started B.Tech Computer Science in Tamil Nadu with very little idea

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: what I was doing. The first programs I wrote barely ran.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: What changed things was realising that almost everything worth learning

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: was already written down, in public, in other people's repositories.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: So I started reading them. I still do, most days.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: 2024 — going lower

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: I got tired of not knowing what was underneath. C++ first, then Rust,

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: which I picked because it refuses to let you stay vague about ownership

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: and lifetimes.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: Learning it was slow and occasionally humiliating, and it taught me more

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: about how machines actually work than the two years before it combined.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: 2025 — building the hard thing

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: I wrote FluxDB, a time-series database, from scratch in Rust. Not

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: because the world needed another one, but because I wanted to find out

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: where the cost really lives inside a storage engine: columnar

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: compression, a write path worth benchmarking, a great deal of profiling.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: Then rustkvd, a distributed key-value store with Raft consensus, an LSM

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: engine and MVCC, for the same reason applied to consensus.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: 2026 — models and agents

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: I began working with Shipd (Datacurve) and Handshake AI, authoring

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: training data and grading model output against detailed rubrics.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: Alongside that: agent systems, RL environments and retrieval pipelines

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: for startups who needed them working, not demonstrated. Evaluation is

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: the part most people skip, and it is the part that decides whether any

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: of it survives contact with real inputs.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: open source

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: OpenTelemetry, CNCF, Helm, oxc, ripgrep.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: Working in codebases that size teaches one specific skill: reading

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: unfamiliar code well enough to change it without breaking anything, then

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: taking the review that follows seriously.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: Much of what I contributed was tests, because tests are how you find out

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: whether you actually understood the thing you just read.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace
ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: now

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: Still building systems. Still reading more code than I write.

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: If you are hiring for backend, systems or cloud-native work, or you have

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: something at an early stage that needs building properly, the contact

text.font-family: ui-monospace, SFMono-Regular, Menlo, Consolas, 'DejaVu Sans Mono', monospace

g.text: details are at the top of this page.
